games.title: Arma Reforger
games.tagline: Cold War combined arms — large-scale infantry, armor, and heli ops.
games.description: Arma Reforger is the next generation of the Arma series, built on the Enfusion engine. Set during the Cold War era, it delivers large-scale combined arms warfare with infantry, armor, helicopters, and more. The Knuckls server runs modded scenarios with persistent PvP campaigns — drop in for coordinated ops or casual play.
features: Large-scale combined arms battles (infantry, armor, heli)
Modded scenarios with custom mission scripts
Persistent PvP campaigns with territory control
Enfusion engine — improved physics and destruction
Cross-platform with Workbench modding tools
Dedicated 64-player server hosted on Knuckls hardware

systemRequirements.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1070 / AMD Radeon RX 580

games.title: StarRupture
games.tagline: Open-world extraction survival in a hostile sci-fi frontier.
games.description: StarRupture is an open-world extraction survival game set on a hostile alien planet. Explore vast biomes, build bases, fight AI creatures and rival players, and extract with valuable loot. Every expedition is a gamble — gear up, go in, and try to make it out alive on the Knuckls server.
features: Open-world extraction survival gameplay loop
Procedural POIs with dynamic loot tables
Base building with full structural integrity
AI creatures with territorial behavior
PvPvE — fight players and the environment
Dedicated server hosted on Knuckls hardware

systemRequirements.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 / AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT

games.title: PalWorld
games.tagline: Build a base, catch Pals, automate production — survival crafting with creature collecting.
games.description: PalWorld is an open-world survival crafting game where you collect and train mysterious creatures called Pals. Build automated bases, explore vast islands, battle bosses, and conquer dungeons. The Knuckls server runs with max Pal settings, friendly base building, and a casual co-op focus — Pals do the work, you do the exploring.
features: Creature collecting with unique Pal abilities
Base automation — Pals work, craft, and fight
Open-world exploration with flying mounts
Boss dungeons and tower challenges
Multiplayer co-op on the Knuckls server
Max Pal settings enabled for faster progression

systemRequirements.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 / AMD Radeon RX 560

games.title: DayZ
games.tagline: Spawn naked, survive zombies, get betrayed by friends — the most punishing survival game.
games.description: DayZ is the hardcore survival game where the story is the prize. Spawn on the coast of Chernarus with nothing but your wits — find food, water, and weapons, fight infected, and navigate a world where every other survivor could be your next friend or your last enemy. The Knuckls server features modded loot, a party system, and a tight-knit community.
features: Hardcore survival with hunger, thirst, temperature, and health
Modded loot economy with enhanced spawns
Party system for team play
Custom-built community zones
PvPvE — infected and players are both threats
Dedicated server hosted on Knuckls hardware

systemRequirements.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 760 / AMD Radeon R9 270X

games.title: Hytale
games.tagline: Sandbox adventure with a deep modding engine — building worlds, not just playing them.
games.description: Hytale is a sandbox adventure game built around a powerful modding engine. Procedurally generated worlds, deep dungeon crawling, and a combat system that rewards skill. But the real power is in the tools — Hytale's modding suite lets you create custom game modes, assets, and entire worlds. The Knuckls server is the go-to spot for early access builds and community content.
features: Procedurally generated block worlds with biomes
Deep dungeon crawling with boss fights
Built-in modding toolkit (no external software needed)
Scriptable game logic with Hytale's scripting system
Community content marketplace
Dedicated server hosted on Knuckls hardware

systemRequirements.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580
